gloss: to wander; to roam; to drift

definitions.gloss: to wander; to roam; to drift; to stray
definitions.explanation: To move about without a fixed destination or purpose; to wander aimlessly.

examples.japanese: {生死|せいし}の{境|さかい}をさまよった。
examples.english: I hovered between life and death.

examples.japanese: {視線|しせん}が{部屋|へや}の{中|なか}をさまよった。
examples.english: My gaze wandered around the room.

notes:
VERB TYPE:
{自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive verb)
Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし})

KANJI:
Can be written as {彷徨|さまよ}う (literary).

CONJUGATION:
・さまよわない (negative)
・さまよって (te-form)
・さまよった (past)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{街|まち}をさまよう - to wander the streets
・{夢|ゆめ}の{中|なか}をさまよう - to drift through dreams
・{生死|せいし}の{境|さかい}をさまよう - to hover between life and death
・{意識|いしき}がさまよう - one's consciousness drifts
